title: A nontrivial critical window for autocatalytic emergence in the binary polymer model
summary: The limiting probability is determined for a reflexively autocatalytic and food-generated (RAF) set in two reversible binary-polymer models. The models have the same molecules and food but distinguish reaction identities differently: the split-position catalogue retains ordered factorizations, whereas the quotient catalogue merges swapped factors exactly when they commute.
